market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: Keisha Lance Bottoms has not formally declared her 2026 gubernatorial candidacy, and the primary remains over a year away. Other strong Democrats—including Stacey Abrams—may enter, making a 94.6% implied probability for Bottoms unrealistically high given primary uncertainties.
evidence_points: Bottoms has not officially announced a 2026 run for Georgia governor.
Stacey Abrams, a high-profile two-time nominee, has not ruled out another campaign.
Primary fields in Georgia often attract multiple credible candidates, and no candidate is virtually certain to win this far out.
